h1.en: Keep Electric 50 Concrete Pump under “Humidity Ratio by Vapor Partial Pressure” without new ratings
h1.zh: 在「湿度 比 通过 水汽 局部 压力」下保留搜索“50”：电动50和柴油50是邢台的两张订单，不另写额定值

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Electric 50 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/electric-50-concrete-pump. It prints 26 m³/h. Diesel 30 prints 15 m³/h. Diesel 50 prints Kawasaki 140. Name fine stone, 13 mm or 24 mm. The 30 m³/h diesel cell is on Diesel 50. Both pages print 30 MPa and a 0.4 m³ hopper. Diesel 50 is 3300 kg and 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm. Electric 50 is 2800 kg and 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm. Electric 50’s specification list used here does not. /en/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/ is the electric path. Send one Electric 50 path and say which row you are buying against. The Diesel 50 description attaches “1 cm aggregate” to 150 m / 450 m. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai does not sell a single machine called “50”. Diesel 50 prints 6105 / 99 kW, 30 m³/h, 30 MPa, 150 m / 450 m, hopper 0.4 m³, Kawasaki 140, 3300 kg. Electric 50 prints 55 kW, 26 m³/h, 30 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, and three distance rows: fine stone 150 m / 350 m, 13 mm stone 80 m / 240 m, 24 mm stone 60 m / 180 m. The section title “Humidity Ratio by Mass” comes from the source page and does not add a rating.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是搜索“50”：电动50和柴油50是邢台的两张订单的数字。要打开的行是 /products/electric-50-concrete-pump。它印 26 m³/h。柴油50印了川崎 140。柴油30印 15 m³/h。此处使用的电动50规格列表没有。写明细石、13 mm 或 24 mm。30 m³/h 的柴油格子在柴油50上。发送一条电动50路径，并写明你对照的是哪一行。两页都印 30 MPa 和 0.4 m³ 料斗。河北品锦机械（邢台）不销售一台名叫“50”的机器。柴油50的说明把“1 cm 骨料”标在 150 m / 450 m 上。柴油50是 3300 kg、4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm。电动50是 2800 kg、4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm。/zh/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/ 是电动路径。柴油50印 6105 / 99 kW、30 m³/h、30 MPa、150 m / 450 m、料斗 0.4 m³、川崎 140、3300 kg。电动50印 55 kW、26 m³/h、30 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³，以及三行距离：细石 150 m / 350 m、13 mm 石子 80 m / 240 m、24 mm 石子 60 m / 180 m。节标题「湿度 比 通过 质量」来自来源页，不另加额定值。
